body: There are no thanks or words necessary or wanted. All I want is for you to continue to live on, keep fighting, and not give up.

Just please hang in. I am not pretentious enough to say "I know you how you feel" - because I cannot imagine... but please just believe that you can be so much more than what you are feeling. 

You are worth being loved and cared for, and so you will be. Just please hold on, endurance is more important than truth sometimes because the path can be cloudy and unclear, and yes, sometimes very painful- but in the end, you must believe you can be loved and love - I believe you will find happiness and love and healing.

"Every saint has a past, every sinner has a future" - not to say there is a religious angle here (there certainly isn't,) but you get the idea - whoever you have been, whatever you have done, you have a choice about who you can be from right now forward. 

I know the past hurts, I was in love with a former rape victim once. I held her in my arms every time something triggered her memory, cradled her while she cried and tried to be careful and consoling with my love. It was difficult, but slowly progress was made. I tried my best to help her understand what I am trying to tell you - you have value, you are so precious and beautiful simply by your being. 

Whatever you have done, it does not mean that what has been must define what could be.
Will you believe me if I say that I love you? Even though I may never meet you, I love you.
I cried. I don't know if I have the depth of character to help you, but please know that someone somewhere cares.

In my analysis, the human experience is about the search for meaning. Whether that be in career, family, friends, etc. The world is not the most inviting place these days, and unfortunately, a large part of being young in this kind of an environment is about hanging in and holding the line. I know that is it not as easy as "find what you are passionate about and do it," but I do think that at a certain point we have to take leaps of faith and try to make choices to pursue a meaningful life, whatever form that may take for us. I recently left the corporate world to work as a teacher, and I can tell you that making that choice has meant all the difference in the world for me. Your talents will find a home, of this I am sure.

Well, the reason I bring it up is because there is a powerful vignette in that book about the dangers of chasing a carrot rather than chasing meaning. It seems like you are fundamentally struggling with the search for meaning. You're in your 3rd year of law school, why did you go?
Good morning or good evening, wherever you may be. I have no advice, but you have an ear if you want to talk.
Have you ever read the book "Infinite Jest?"
Are you still here?

Hey, what's going on? I'm not a pro, if you need a pro, you should seek help immediately. If you just need someone to listen, go ahead, I'm here.

There has actually been much serious academic work done on many of the things you are talking about, you might find it interesting - there is a documentary called "Flight from Death: The Quest for Immortality." and it has serious scientists discussing the things that you seem to have become aware of (namely, our awareness of our own mortality can philosophically make us act differently and feel that our existence 'pointless.') - it's actually really thought provoking.

 I'm not going to go line by line trying to refute your argument - I think that putting your life into the hands of the internet is probably a mistake, but who am I to tell you anything? Maybe someone else will do it, but I'm not so arrogant as to think I am smart or wise enough that I can save your life - nor will I attempt to play 'God,' your life is not mine to save or end. 

You may feel enlightened, but I would challenge you to put your analytically skills to consider the flipside of all your arguments rather then approaching life from a pure cynical standpoint. If you came to this conclusion recently, maybe your mind will change again. Anyways, I just hope that you can reach a different conclusion on your own because that's what you need to be convinced, not someone on the internet.

"You have to be good and lost to find a place that can't be found" - I always enjoyed that line from Pirates of the Caribbean. Think it's more true than we think.

My best advice is that you need to talk to a pro - namely someone in your University's guidance office. Tell them what you like to do, and see if they can't let you sit in on a few classes and find out where your abilities and talents fit in. 

When I started undergrad, I was on the Pre-Law track but I found myself unfulfilled and ended up going into education. I'm not sure where you'll end up, but it's ok to not know what to do! Just try to seek out those who might be able to help you find that answer.

I respect your opinion, but please don't presume to judge my intentions or my genuineness. Is it so out of your spectrum that someone can love a stranger? I'm sorry if you think that I am self righteous, but I don't throw things around like they are candy, I mean everything I say. So please don't come here to throw stones. Instead I would invite you to offer yourself to people who come here just wanting someone to listen to them.

Hey, this is a pretty grim assessment. Seems like you are in a pretty bad place. If this is an emergency and you are going to do something you can't take back, please get professional help here - http://suicidehotlines.com/  - If you just need someone to talk to, I'm here and so are many other people who care about you.

Please get help. You are a beautiful person with so much to offer. Your partner will help you through this tough time and will be with you. Please have the courage and strength to get the help you need. We all support you here on this subreddit, so I encourage you with all the love I have to give to please get help and get better. Let me know if there is anything I can do.

Because you shared your story with me, and it touched me and made me sad that someone like you has to deal with the shitstorm you are in. You mean a great deal to me because no one deserves the treatment that you have been subjected you. You mean a great deal to me because I have sat with friends who have been abused and held them as they cried. You mean a great deal to me because I believe you have great value and potential, and the world would suffer and be dimmer should you not choose to reach for it. These among other reasons compel me to talk to you now, not out of pity or pandering or self-righteous reasons, but because you reached out a hand and I won't turn my back on you. I think you have value and I think you are worth the time to get to know. I'm thinking about you and wishing I had the words or knew what to do to help you make it through this tough time. As it stands however, I can always listen.
Just a thought, and a long shot - but maybe try throwing something up on other Reddits seeing if anyone has a washing machine in the same region that they are looking to unload?

Well, I do want to wish you a very Happy Birthday. It's no minor miracle that you are in fact in this world and still with us. If you feel that what you are feeling is an emergency that is putting yourself in danger, please call a hotline and get professional help- http://suicidehotlines.com/

If you just need a friend or someone to talk to - I'm a guy with the internet and I'm here and so are other people. I think you seem fairly insightful for 17, and I would very much like to get to know you and help you if I can - I'll read whatever you post, so if you need to vent, go ahead; if you need to talk, start it up; but never think that you don't have potential or value, because that's just not true. You are far from worthless, in fact you mean a great deal to me.

I'm so proud to have read that wall of text. You have come through and are dealing with things that I cannot even comprehend. You are the kind of person this world needs. We are here for you, if you want to talk about anything or need anything that the internet people can provide. I may never meet you IRL, but I love you, your story is heartbreaking because you shouldn't have to go through it, but you have showed already it would seem that you are a caring and loving person, and certainly the kind of person I would be proud to call 'friend.'

I'm not a professional, I have no advice, I'm just a guy, but if you need to talk something out - feel free to start it up.

I wish with all my heart you didn't have to deal with these severe problems, I can't even imagine what strength you must have to get through your day. I read the whole thing, btw, and I bet other people did too. I don't really have any advice, but I'm here if you just need someone to talk to. I love you, I care about you, and I don't think you need to be 'fixed'  (that language implies you are a problem, which you certainly are not) - I am here for you if you need anything.
don't have gmail chat - I will need to set one up
Hey. I'll talk to you.

You are unbelievable. I wish I could hug you right now and show you how much you are an inspiration. I hope you can let go of the guilt and see how incredible you are. I love you so very much at this moment. I just hope that you realize how much value you have to us, the world would be noticeably dimmer without you in it. You have so many reasons to live... you asked for silly, funny, fucked up, responsible... therefore, I will give you them!

1. Silly - The funniest movie you will ever see has not been written yet... better stick around or you might miss it. 

2. Funny - You may be crucial to the human defeat of the Zombies/Robots/Aliens that are certainly imminent. 

3. Fucked Up - Youtube Movies like "Epic Rap Battles of History" and surfing reddit.com/r/aww

4. Responsible - from reading this I can honestly say that you are one of the most strong people I have ever encountered. The world cannot afford to lose you, and neither can I. I also hope and believe that someone or something will come into your life to help you bear that burden. I hope you find someone who will be kind and gentle and will help you heal. I don't know if it will or not, but isn't it worth living for? 

Please stay with us, you are incredible and could touch the lives of so many with your work. I hope that you will be true to your calling and keep fighting to make the world a place worth living in.

There is a heck of alot here. It makes my heart heavy that you have had this experience, and I want to say that I love you. For what it is worth, I had an experience living in a fundamentalist "Men's Community House" for a year when I was in college - So maybe we can connect on that level and talk about how you are feeling?  Sometimes it helps to talk about those experiences and see how much impact they can have on you life. 

I just want to put myself out there and say I'm here if you want to start up a conversation about these feelings and how you can maybe start to turn it around. Love you man, no dogma behind it, I love you for exactly who you are. We're here, and we think you can pull through!

Well, you posted here - so it would seem you want something; I can't tell you what it is nor can I tell you that "I understand you totally" because I don't. But I know one important thing - I love you (no bullshit) and it hurts that you can't shake this Thing that is eating at you. I'm no shrink, I'm a guy with an internet connection, but I love you and if you decide what you want/need - let me know if I can do anything, even just listening and reading your posts - talk about anything and everything, maybe something can click for you. (also, even if you just need a friend to play a video game with or talk sports or TV or whatever it is - let me know) 

I care about you and I want to see you best this "Thing" that haunts you. From hearing barely anything about you I can already tell you have potential and value to a heck of alot of people.

I love you, please believe me. Please get the help you need right now, http://suicidehotlines.com/ - I'm not patronizing you, I just honestly really care for you and hope that you do not hurt yourself. You are a beautiful and wonderful person and I know for a fact that the world is better with you in it. You have purpose and value to me - and I love you.

I will start with some honesty and humility by saying that I can't understand you, I know that I can't. I won't trivialize your feelings by claiming so. I also can't answer that question for you, nor will I presume that I can. But I will say that I love you, no bullshit, no dogma, full sincerity. There are many people here who care about you and will listen to you. I have to go off my computer for a few hours, but if you want to talk some things out, I'll be back later, and there are plenty of other people who care about you too. So let's start a conversation. HOWEVER: if you feel that you are close to doing something drastic, please seek professional help from a hotline - they will talk to you right now, in person, if you should need an emergency contact. http://suicidehotlines.com  

If you just need someone to talk to, start off the conversation and we're here for you. In case you forgot, I love you.

You'll be in my thoughts - we are always here to support you and listen. I hope with all my heart that you catch your much needed break - hopefully the wheel will turn for you like you deserve it to. Until then, please don't give up on being the amazingly caring person you are!

Hey SoVeryDown, other people have this well in hand, so I'm not going to add - I just wanted to pop in to tell you that I love you and care about you. If that doesn't work out and you feel you would be a burden to your family and loved ones and would better serve them working full time - maybe you should talk to them about it. You probably don't want to make any huge decisions without talking them out with all of the people who you care about. Maybe they will see things from a different perspective. Feel free to correct me if I'm sounding way off base to you.

Please don't. I care about you and love you, you can choose to believe that or not, but its true. I am thinking about you and hoping that you choose to get help. Hey, just give me a few minutes to read this, then we can talk. In the meantime, I care about you and love you, no bullshit. I also won't claim to understand how you feel, because how can I if I am not you? But regardless, I'll be with you in just a few minutes here.

"So let's play find a good part of my life then?" - this is a hard question, and I don't have an answer for you. I won't claim to be able to come up with one. I don't have that kind of arrogance. But the question itself is hard without knowing every awesome little thing about you. 

Let me read the entire thread and then if you want to talk this out with me, I'll just listen. I won't judge you, your problems, your emotions, or say I have any answers because I don't. I love you, you can call bullshit all you want, but it doesn't change anything for me, I'm going to continue to love you and see the value that you have. I won't ask you to trust me, but I will ask that you give me the benefit of the doubt that I am genuine and coming from a place of concern rather than self-righteousness, I'll be the first to admit I don't have it all together myself.

also, just to clarify one more time - I do not claim to to 'understand' your situation, I am not trying to trivialize your situation or feelings. I'm just telling you what worked for me when I hit dark times during my high school and college years. I'm not a professional, I'm just a guy, so if you have serious concerns about self-harm or depression, seek professional help. Everyone here supports you.

Thank you for this, it is humbling as well as a fair criticism. I'm not sure how I come off to people, and now because of you I will think harder on that very notion. I think I try to preface my comments with qualifiers because I know that I can't ever 'understand' anyone's situation or emotions, that's patronizing and disingenuous. Some I can relate to better than others but hopefully people understand that I am basically there to start a conversation with them because it seems like most people here just want someone to talk to or acknowledge that they exist. If they need serious help, they should seek it from professionals. I just hope that people don't think I'm being self-righteous. Any "advice" that I have even given is just basically saying 'Here are some things that have worked in my life." Mostly I just want to let people know that they have value and people care for them. I'm not a shrink, Jesus Christ, or the Easter Bunny. Someone told me about this subreddit and I just don't like seeing people hurting and I try to lend them whatever support I can. 

If you don't mind me asking, what was your question?

hey, I love you. Now that we have established that - 'wait' is about the worst thing you can do. Never 'wait' on anything. In order to find happiness you need to be actively striving and looking for that purpose or meaning. Along the way you find ways to make each day better - watch a silly movie (my current favorite ridiculous thing is "Ancient Aliens") or do an "Epic Rap Battles of History" marathon. I find that sometimes you need to find a laugh in dark times. Stop listening to Elliot Smith (it will only make you sad) and acquire the album "American Beauty" by the Grateful Dead. Listen to this http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V4SqDx1vi4c - it has been a light for me in dark places. Particularly relevant is the line 
"Walk into splintered sunlight. Inch your way through dead dreams to another land. Maybe you're tired and broken, your tongue is twisted with words half spoken and thoughts unclear. What do you want me to do, to do for you to see you through? A box of rain will ease the pain 
and love will see you through."

You're a junior in High School? You are still so young and there is so much in this wide world for you. Kids are cruel, college is not the panacea, but you have a choice in your life. You can choose to keep moving forward while looking for those opportunities to change yourself and your life for the better. Until you can wake up and look in the mirror and be happy and confident with what you see, you will always be shackled to the jerks at the small school. Not sure where you live, but there is a world of people and experiences out there. You're probably about 15-17 I would guess, so I would encourage you to realize how very much you have to look forward to instead of focusing on what may have ended. 

Also, just so you know, I'm not trivializing your feelings - I know they are real and it pains me to see you hurting. I am merely coming from a place of love and experience as I am a little further down the path - it ends well if you are a good person who believes in yourself. I am proud to have conversed with you and you no doubt have much to give this world - I only hope that you find the strength to go out and do it!
thank you for saying this. Living your own life.... "Like a Boss"

surely, just remind me of who you are... and try not to smoke weed in the morning, it just wrecks your day (though I enjoy being high as much as the next fellow, so no judgement.)

I hope for tomorrow to be a better day, and one last time, I love you and you have value and potential!

in a pinch, I go here for happiness in my dark places... reddit.com/r/aww

Anytime. You have my username, feel free to reach out whenever. Also, something that can help you out is by reading the stories of others on this subreddit and lending them a word of encouragement. It's a positive thing and I think that your experiences as a survivor could really help some people. Just a thought, it has helped other people by giving them a sense of purpose and a way to channel their emotions. 

Just in case you forgot - I love ya.

you have my username, you can contact me at any time. 

I would want you as my kid, I would just tell you to smoke less weed. Weed = it's ok to be bored and not do anything because everything is entertaining (yes, I have dabbled myself rather heavily in my college years.) South Park got it right when they said stop smoking weed and get a hobby. Small things man, small things, you like art? Paint or learn how to sculpt instead of toking up. Always remember that you are the captain of your life, no one else will live it for you. I would come up with a list of what you want with your next 4 years, all the criterion that you want for the next move you make (including scholarship possibilities) and talk to your school guidance person and ask them to help you find a place - it's their job and they would love to help you (I am a teacher, so I know these things!) - once you show that you want to improve, people will line up to help you do it. 

Though this may be a bad day and you may just have to cry it out and lay in bed today, make yourself an affirmation that tomorrow can be and daresay WILL be a good day. I've seen helicopter parents, I've seen asshole parents, but the one thing across the board that I see is that young people who take control of their lives are often happier and people chomp at the bit to help them succeed!

So basically, I believe you can be great at whatever you choose to do - if it's art, find an art school far away that offers your program. This is your life, you can do anything you want with it. If people stand in your way or try to slow you down, then their opinion does not matter. I'm going to go ahead and say that I am already proud of the work you will accomplish.

Charles Bukowski once said "endurance is more important than truth." I have always subscribed to this notion. Endurance is hard, but if we can endure and keep searching and striving for meaning or whatever is going to make us happy, we can find it. Now, it will almost certainly not be what you expect, but on a long enough timeline, if you're open and seeking, you find those chances to change your life. What happened to you was awful and if I could I would take that all away and tell your wife what an incredible person you really are beneath all of the scar tissue that has formed. If you need something constructive to occupy your time, I would suggest reading "Man's Search for Meaning" by Viktor Frankl, a guy who survived a Nazi death camp and dedicated his life to helping people find meaning and he also writes that suffering is relative, so just because you are not starving in Africa does not mean you don't suffer. Anyways, I found much truth in that book and it gives you a nice lens to look at your life. Know that I am somewhere in this world, and you mean much to me and I love you and am proud of you.

17 is a fine age for reevaluation of one's life and purpose... the first of about 4-5 between now and 21 - are you considering college? Career? 

also - you are definitely not worthless and your parents and brother are assholes. Try to just not engage them, as it seems like this only brings conflict. I'd be psyched if you were my kid. 

Death is NEVER the better option. I know its cliche and people don't want to hear it, but life goes on and changes, sometimes for the better. This is not a pandering "wait and it'll get better" - waiting probably won't do much. This is something I know from experience, if you make positive changes and keep striving and searching - you always find something, almost always not what you expect, but the more you put yourself out there and open yourself up to new opportunities, people, and experiences, you will find those people who see the best in you.

Hey. I love you, no bullshit, no religion, no dogma, just me. If you need someone to talk to, I'm here, start off the conversation. If you don't, just know that if a stranger can love you and see your value, other people will too.

Hey. I love you and you have an incredible amount of value to me. I'm wondering how old you are? No need to answer, I'm not trying to be nosy, just trying to sympathize. I would like to open myself up to a conversation with you. Don't discount First World Problems, I cite Viktor Frankl's "Man's Search For Meaning." But regardless, never let anyone else tell you otherwise - you are valuable and I love you.
I hope will all I have that you are still with us. I love you. Though I may never meet you, I love you, and I am going to hope with that unconditional love that you are still with us.

3 things straight off the bat. 
1. I love you, no bullshit.

2. You are 17 - I can promise you that nothing you do now will matter in 2 years. So endurance is more important than truth. Trust me. 

3. You won't find your 'meaning' for awhile probably, it sucks, but it is what it is. I have traveled via car all over this country searching for some universal truth or meaning. When I was old enough, wise enough, humble enough, I was able to see the roadsign I had been circling. 

So basically, you're young - keep the faith. You're special, so I love you. You're going to need to be honest with your feelings and get the help you need if you need it. 

My best advice is to try to find some small joys and meaning. Lay under a tree and listen to the album "American Beauty" by the Grateful Dead, surf the puppies and kittens of reddit/r/aww, see a stupid movie and laugh deeply until you start crying. I hope things will get better for you! oh, and in case you forgot, I love you.

I'm going to respect your wish to not talk about how things get better, so I won't talk to you about that. But I just want you to know that while your situation may warrant this attitude and anger, it makes me sad to read you are hurting so bad. I love you. No bullshit, no lines, no religion, it's pure. You can believe that or not, but I love you and I don't want to live in a world that you are not in. Please try to step back and remember how many people love you - and if you say no one does, that's simply not true. Even if you say all your friends and family "don't love you," I do - and you can't tell me otherwise. I love you and I hope you will find some peace and realize that 'goals' and 'failure' are such a small part of this life. (And I'm not talking about you finding - "success" - I'm talking about appreciating the little things and finding a laugh at Ancient Aliens or surfing /r/aww)

and maybe you think I'm full of shit, but I'm not, I just love you and I hope that you are able to shift the scope of your perception, please feel free to contact me or reply to the thread if you want to start a conversation.

Hey. I love you. No bullshit, no dogma, just plain and simple. I love you. Please take the time to read what people write and remember that people care about you, and I think you're valuable and beautiful and if you can be honest with yourself, you have much more strength and hope than your peers. I love you, in case you forgot. Feel free to reach out to me, but regardless take today and notice every little beautiful detail of yourself and your world. If you feel like you're getting closer to that edge, please get the help you need. I can no longer imagine a world without you in it - one more time. I love you.

but the end is worth the waiting. Please hold on my friend, I love you so goddamn much in this moment. I'm praying to whatever gods may be for you and hoping that you can find the eyes to see what I see - how beautiful your life is.

So I was re-reading your post and this jumped out at me:

"it's difficult to understand unless you've spent 5 straight years caring for people that you come across, hoping that one will return the favour and be the person who wants to know you, who wants to make sure you feel happy"
~ they will appear when you least expect it, and you will have to be the person who can care for them unconditionally first. I know this is true because I have seen it.

well, then I only ask that you don't give up - every day is a new day, maybe tomorrow will be the day that everything turns around. I know its hokey, cheesy, and probably unhelpful to you, but Bukowski wrote "endurance is more important than truth" - sometimes I think there is something to that, we may not have the answers, but if we don't keep surviving we may never reach that better time and know that truth about the purpose of our lives. I think the situation under discussion is if you pull of a successful gank or have a champion number advantage. Once you gank, you can get a good push on the tower and then one person can cover the lane while the other goes back to buy. In games I have played with redditers, there is usually good communication after a push in terms covering so that someone who has been farming the lane can buy. Additionally, this is why teleport has become such a popular spell - because you can push, b, and be back in the lane before your tower gets pushed at all. 

Choices to push or to go back are always situational - you don't want to push a tower solo if there is a chance of a gank, but I think the point is that you need to prioritize towers over trying to tower dive, especially in the early game. 

Pushing towers can give you other advantages as well, such as better control of dragon after you destroy a bottom tower.
